working_definition: A small (9-cell) population of adult brain neurons expressing crustacean cardioactive peptide (CCAP), recovered by targeted re-clustering of neuropeptide-expressing cells in Davie et al. 2018 (57K adult brain atlas). CCAP-expressing neurons are a classically studied, molecularly and functionally defined population (CCAP-GAL4, Luan et al. 2006) implicated in ecdysis, cardiac/abdominal muscle modulation, and post-eclosion wing expansion with bursicon; the brain-restricted subset captured here is not resolved to any single morphological subtype. Independently corroborated as a distinct cluster (res-8.0 cluster 151) in the same paper.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult neuron that expresses CCAP (Crustacean cardioactive peptide) (FBgn0039007).

justification: The cluster is explicitly a CCAP-gene-expression-defined class (per Luan et al. 2006, the same driver/reference tradition FBbt uses to define this class), not a single morphological cell type. FBbt:00111316 'adult CCAP neuron' is defined at exactly this level -- any adult neuron expressing CCAP -- matching the report's own conclusion that class-level granularity is the honest target. Adult stage is correct for this atlas (whole adult brain, ages 1-30 days). The cluster is well corroborated within the paper (independent res-8.0 cluster 151, same literature marker), supporting high confidence despite the small cell number.

other_candidates.reason_rejected: Stage-unspecified parent of 'adult CCAP neuron'; less specific than the adult-stage term which correctly applies to this adult-brain atlas.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Neuron from Selcho et al. (2018) mapped to a specific brain CCAP neuron type with defined morphology and lineage.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: A specific named subtype (one of several adult CCAP neuron populations); this transcriptomic cluster cannot be resolved to this or any other single anatomical subtype (SEZ, protocerebrum, thoracic, abdominal variants all exist).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00111316 'adult CCAP neuron' as an exact match at the class level; do not attempt to resolve to a specific CCAP neuron subtype as the transcriptomic cluster does not support this.
